summary: A 1948 L-4 timber tower on the Umpqua National Forest, still staffed in fire season and rented as a cabin the rest of the year.

access.note: Rentable via Recreation.gov Oct 15–Jul 15; staffed by Forest Service during fire season.

visit.trail_note: Access roads unplowed/unmaintained for passenger cars; steep narrow 40-ft stairway to the cab.

events.note: Replaced by the current 41-foot timber tower with L-4 cab.
firelookout.com states it was staffed up to the 1998 fire season before moving to the rental program.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, September 2000.
Returned to active staffing starting in 2001 while remaining an off-season rental.

evidence.supports: NHLR registration date and dual-use description
evidence.quote: Carefully restored for the cabin rental program, it has remained in active service in the summer, while being available for rental in the non-fire season

evidence.supports: original lookout and 1948 replacement, access conditions
evidence.quote: The original lookout was 25 feet tall and built in 1934. In 1948 the tower was replaced with the current flat top structure.
In 1898, homesteader William T. Pickett rode into this area on horseback and decided to stay and build a life and home.

evidence.supports: 1934 L-5 pole tower, 1948 L-4 replacement, staffing history
evidence.quote: Developed with a 25' pole L-5 tower in 1934, the present 41' treated timber L-4 tower, built in 1948, was staffed up to the 1998 fire season.
It was then placed on the Recreation Rental program, but was staffed again starting in 2001.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's detail page lists a 1958 build date for the current structure, but recreation.gov and firelookout.com both describe a 1934 25-foot original tower replaced in 1948 by the present L-4 tower. The story notes this discrepancy rather than picking one date as certain.

NHLR describes the cab as 'a classic 14' x 14' L-4', but Recreation.gov's facilities listing calls it 'a 12 x 12 room.' firelookout.com gives no dimension. The story notes both figures rather than picking one.

sources.title: Pickett Butte Lookout, Umpqua National Forest

notes_for_editor: Build-year conflict between NHLR (1958) and recreation.gov/firelookout.com (1934 original, 1948 current tower) is unresolved; flagged in both the story and resolved_conflicts. height_m corrected to ~12.5 (41-ft tower) in facts; the original brief's 7.6 figure appears to have been cab-only or an error and has been applied/fixed. Fact-check 2026-10-04 also found and fixed a footnote misattribution (the homesteader sentence cited firelookout.com, which never mentions 1898/Pickett, instead of recreation.gov) and a cab-dimension conflict between NHLR (14'x14') and recreation.gov (12x12) that the brief had not flagged; both are now noted in the story and resolved_conflicts.
